goal: Prevent signing PSBT inputs using SIGHASH_SINGLE when there is no matching output at the same index
Protects PSBT signers from producing transaction-independent signatures that allow fund redirection
reviewability: Ready to review; nothing known that would invalidate review
agreement: Support without stated reasons and no open objections

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because it eliminates a fund safety risk during PSBT signing
Prevents signatures that commit to no outputs, which could allow funds to be redirected without consent
